question: Identify the full names of members who incurred an expense over $100 that was budgeted under the 'Food' category for any event held in September.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T4."XCL_035", T4."XCL_036"
FROM expense AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1."XCL_023" = T2."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2."XCL_009" = T3."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN member AS T4 ON T1."XCL_022" = T4."XCL_034"
WHERE T1."XCL_020" > 100
  AND T2."XCL_004" = 'Food'
  AND SUBSTRING(T3."XCL_012", 6, 2) = '09'

FROM expense AS T1
